name: Bezos Expeditions
identity_check: Confirmed as Bezos Expeditions (bezosexpeditions.com), the family office that manages Jeff Bezos's personal investments (Wikipedia; CNBC 2024 and Family Wealth Report 2026 both call it his family office; founded 2005). The firm's site is a one-page list of 'Selected Investments' plus links to Bezos's other ventures. It is not Blue Origin, the Washington Post, the Bezos Day One Fund, the Bezos Family Foundation or the 10,000 Year Clock (all linked from the same site as separate Bezos projects). It is not Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund or the Alexa Fund: both appear as separate co-investors next to Bezos Expeditions in Skild AI's Series A, and the Industrial Innovation Fund also invested in RIVR's seed round. Project Prometheus is an operating company Bezos co-founded and co-runs; its June 2026 Series B is kept because Family Wealth Report (citing CNBC/FINTRX) counts it as a Bezos Expeditions round, while the deal record itself names 'Jeff Bezos'. Rounds where the source names only 'Jeff Bezos' were kept only when the company is on the firm's own Selected Investments list (Physical Intelligence, Periodic Labs) or a press page attributes the deal to Bezos Expeditions (General Intuition, Prometheus). Sources also write the firm as 'Bezos Expeditions Fund' (Perplexity) and 'Bezos Expedition' (SiliconANGLE).

thesis_text.value: Jeff Bezos's family office (founded 2005), investing his own capital without outside LPs in early- and late-stage private companies. Long tilted toward technology (about 70% of its investments per FINTRX); since 2024 its tracked deals have been mostly AI, clustered in robot foundation models and physical AI, often joining or co-leading nine- and ten-figure rounds.

open_items: No application URL, contact form, email or pitch guidance on bezosexpeditions.com: the page's contact block holds only a 'Follow @JeffBezos' X button. Cold inbound left as unknown.
No check size stated anywhere; CNBC (2024) says Bezos's individual amounts in the rounds are not disclosed.

No stated sector focus: the firm's site has no description, only a 'Selected Investments' list. The sector mix CNBC quotes (70% technology, 16% consumer goods, 13% financial services, 13% manufacturing) is FINTRX data, not the firm's own words, so stated_sectors is left out.
No reported portfolio count. The site lists 31 'Selected Investments'. Family Wealth Report (citing CNBC/FINTRX) counts eight direct investments in 2026 by early July, five of them in June.
HQ (Mercer Island, WA) comes only from database pages (Wikipedia, Altss); no firm or press page confirms it.
Stages are taken from Wikipedia/Altss ('early and late stage') plus the observed rounds (seed to late-stage). No pre-seed deal found.

Team: the firm publishes no team page. Melinda Lewison's 'Managing Director' title comes only from the Altss database profile. No partner focused on AI, robotics or industrial was found. No company LinkedIn page is linked from the firm's site.

Nothing found on investing in Indian founders or on requiring a US entity. The portfolio includes Zurich-based RIVR and Cambridge (UK)-based CuspAI, but their legal structure at investment was not checked.

SEC EDGAR full-text search shows Bezos Expeditions mentioned in Nebius Group 6-K filings (May 2025, the Toloka deal), but EDGAR Archives refused the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent, so the filings were not read. Toloka rests on one press page (TipRanks).
Site link errors on bezosexpeditions.com: the 'Field AI' entry links to co.bot and the 'Figure' entry links to fieldai.com. Company websites here use each company's own domain.

Rounds that name only 'Jeff Bezos' (Physical Intelligence 2024 and 2025, Periodic Labs, General Intuition, Prometheus) are kept as Bezos Expeditions rounds because the company is on the firm's list or Family Wealth Report attributes the deal to the firm. Some may be personal investments.
Generalist AI's ~$200M late-stage round (Aug 2026) is sourced only to Dealroom News, which cites a federal filing. No press page was fetched.

Not recorded: Figure's Series C (Sept 2025; the announcement does not name Bezos or Bezos Expeditions); Skild AI's 2025 Series B (database directories only); Collaborative Robotics (on the firm's list, but no round page naming Bezos Expeditions found); Flourish (June 2026, named by Family Wealth Report but not researched); Heartland Robotics' 2009 $7M round (BioSpace says Bezos Expeditions took part; too old to include).
Other companies on the list (Anduril, Slate Auto, Insitro, HistoSonics, Stark Bank, Arrived, Rescale, Wildtype and more) were not researched: outside the target sectors or the 24-month window.

Not stated on the pages fetched: founding years and HQs for Generalist AI, Prometheus, General Intuition, Periodic Labs, FieldAI, Toloka and Perplexity; CuspAI's website. Skild AI's Series C valuation is only 'over $14 billion'. RIVR's seed valuation is not given; Trending Topics says the company was 'most recently valued at $100 million'.
